title: Remove the historical mailbox participant reactivation repair after assessing live coordination rows
outcome: Split out of the tm-7p9z.9 final no-legacy audit (Fable, 2026-09-05). ensure_mailbox_session_active in src/mailboxes.rs still repairs participant rows that were invalidated by older send probes; the current mark_session_left runs only after a successful persisted session removal, so the repair is a compatibility path for rows written by earlier builds. It was deliberately NOT removed inside .9 because the live coordination database carries the mailboxes the coordination itself runs on: removing the repair blindly could leave a participant stuck as "left". Steps: (1) state the exact row predicate the repair matches; (2) prove from current code that no current writer can produce that state; (3) assess whether such rows exist in the live coordination store without opening the live SQLite from an external process (use the HTTP mailbox list for the running server, or a stopped-server copy under target/); (4) if none exist, remove the repair and its tests, keeping the root eligibility and deletion race guards; if some exist, record them and decide with Greg whether a one-time reset is acceptable under the unreleased-state policy. Cross-reference: tm-7p9z.9 classification list, docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md.
acceptance: Row predicate documented; current-code proof recorded; live-state assessment recorded without touching the live SQLite externally; repair and tests removed only when no live rows depend on it, otherwise a Greg decision is recorded; Rust gates green.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
